name: eoxhub-notebooks
description: MyST project with custom script injection

scripts.build: myst build --site && mkdir -p _build/html && cp -r _build/site/* _build/html/ 2>/dev/null || true && node inject-scripts.js && python3 .github/workflows/generate_notebook_list.py && cp notebooks.json _build/html/notebooks.json && cp index.html _build/html/index.html && cp _static/eoxhub_jupyter.jpg _build/html/build/_assets/previews 2>/dev/null || true && touch _build/html/.nojekyll
